name: Soft Aurora
rationale: Clean-room WebGL port written from the one-line effect description only (no upstream source read): a dependency-free fragment shader lays two faint, slowly swaying aurora curtains behind hero panels and cards as a quiet base layer, with a static two-colour CSS wash when WebGL is unavailable.

colorA.description: First curtain colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb; also tints the CSS fallback wash.

colorB.description: Second curtain colour, as #rgb or #rrggbb; also tints the CSS fallback wash.

speed.description: Sway speed; 0 holds a still frame.

intensity.description: Brightness of the wash; keep it low under text.

height.description: Height of the band line, 0 (bottom) to 1 (top).

a11y: The injected canvas is aria-hidden and pointer-events: none; the host's content, reading order and focus behaviour are unchanged.
The wash stays dark at default intensity, but its brightest band can sit behind text, so text on it should carry a shadow or scrim to keep 4.5:1 contrast (the demo does this).
Reduced motion stops the shader loop and the fallback sway and shows one still frame of the aurora.
Forced-colors mode hides the canvas and paints the host in Canvas/CanvasText with a visible border.
